### Contribution Checklist

Please verify the following before submitting your Pull Request:

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The link is valid, active, and accessible via HTTPS.
- [ ] The resource is directly relevant to Israel (Israeli-made or focused on the Israeli market).
- [ ] The entry is placed in **alphabetical order** within its section.
- [ ] The format matches: `- [Resource Name](URL) - Short, objective description ending with a period.`
- [ ] The description does not contain subjective hype or promotional spam.
